description: OKF Viewer least-privilege capabilities: dialog (folder picker), store (settings/recent), opener (resource URLs in the OS browser), and an opt-in updater (a user-initiated 'Check for updates' — the only network path, never automatic). No webview filesystem access — the Rust core does all reads. 'pop-*' covers the pop-out reader windows (docs/proposals/multi-view.md), which run the same app and need the same window chrome permissions; create-webview-window lets a tab undock into one.
